title: The war dead and the rise of Labour: did the places that lost most men turn left?
excerpt: I set the names on Britain's First World War memorials against every election from 1906 to 1924. Places with more names swung less to Labour, not more.
seo_description: First World War memorial names against the 1918 to 1924 elections: places that lost more men swung less to Labour, not more.
